subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: When a configured screenshot vision model fails at runtime, should OpenClaw preserve a model-visible screenshot recovery path, or intentionally return only a text failure and explicit share hint?
rationale: This is an existing-user fallback and recovery contract, not a mechanical test gap: the branch intentionally trades screenshot recoverability for avoiding retained image state.

options.title: Preserve safe recovery
options.body: Keep a model-visible recovery route while ensuring raw image data cannot persist into later session tool-result history.

options.title: Accept text-only failure
options.body: Approve the text-only configured-vision failure contract and require current-main real handler/session proof plus user-facing upgrade rationale.

recommendation.title: Preserve safe recovery
recommendation.body: Keep a model-visible recovery route while ensuring raw image data cannot persist into later session tool-result history.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the concrete behavior analysis and can route the requested fallback decision to the appropriate browser/session owner.
